Entity.name: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
Entity.commentInRDBMS: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge where the applicable accounting standard is nGAAP.

Attribute.name: At cost-based method or Lower of costs or market (LOCOM) indicator
Attribute.comment: At cost based method or Lower of costs or market (LOCOM) indicator distinguishes the used accounting portfolio for national General Accepted Accounting Principles (nGAAP) between those that use the At cost based method or Lower of costs or market (LOCOM), and those that do not use At cost based method or Lower of costs or carket (LOCOM).
